title: Rethinking Diffusion Segmentation: When Does It Rely on Its Noisy State, and Does Diffusion Matter?
abstract: arXiv:2609.23967v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly adapted from generation to conditional prediction, where a conditioning signal is combined with an evolving noisy representation of the target. In fully supervised segmentation, however, the conditioning image can already support direct target prediction, so endpoint performance alone establishes neither reliance on the added diffusion state nor a deterministic advantage over image-only prediction. For state reliance, we disrupt target-derived state content or correct image-state pairing during retraining of twelve published methods across three datasets, with ten matched seeds per setting. All 40 original-method comparisons whose evaluated-mask routes remained downstream of noised-quantity reconstruction exhibited state reliance, whereas all 30 comparisons with a segmentation-supervised bypass preserved reference performance. translated_title: 重新思考扩散分割：它何时依赖其噪声状态？扩散真的重要吗？
translated_abstract: 扩散模型正越来越多地从生成任务被改造用于条件预测任务，其中条件信号与目标不断演化的噪声表示相结合。然而，在全监督分割中，条件图像本身已足以支持对目标的直接预测，因此仅凭端点性能既无法证明模型对所添加扩散状态的依赖，也无法证明其相对于仅用图像预测具有确定性优势。针对状态依赖性问题，我们在三个数据集上对十二种已发表方法进行重训练，通过破坏源自目标的状态内容或纠正图像-状态配对来加以检验，每种设置采用十个匹配的随机种子。结果显示：所有40个其评估掩码路径仍处于噪声量重建下游的原始方法比较均表现出状态依赖性，而所有30个具有分割监督旁路的比较则保持了参考性能。通过强制分割监督对五种原本具备旁路能力的方法进行重新路由……
tldr: 该研究通过对十二种已发表的扩散分割方法进行破坏状态内容或纠正图像-状态配对的系统性实验，揭示了只有评估路径依赖噪声量重建的方法才真正依赖噪声扩散状态，而具备分割监督旁路的方法并不依赖扩散过程。
en_tdlr: Through systematic experiments disrupting state content or correcting image-state pairing across twelve published diffusion segmentation methods, this study reveals that only methods whose mask evaluation routes remain downstream of noised-quantity reconstruction genuinely rely on the noisy diffusion state, while those with a segmentation-supervised bypass do not.
